milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the mossy cobblestone wall. Target is the midpoint of the east wall segment at spawn-relative (4, 1, 1). Max distance reduced to 5 (from original 16) per ValidatorAgent feedback, forcing the player to actually walk toward the wall rather than triggering from spawn (~6 blocks away). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must enter the cottage and visually identify the green bed. Target is the bed head at spawn-relative (-5, 1, 5). Max distance of 5 ensures the player is inside or at the doorway of the cottage (doorway is at approximately (-4.5, 1, 3), ~2-3 blocks from the bed). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking toward the bed.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' because this is a place/build task — the player must physically place a dandelion block in the world. The search box (-6,0,-4) to (3,2,6) covers the entire garden interior inside the mossy cobblestone walls. Only dandelions are in the player's inventory (poppies removed per CommonSenseAgent feedback), so this unambiguously checks the correct flower type. The coarse dirt plot at (-1,0)-(1,1) and surrounding grass_block both accept dandelion placement.
